scientific_integrity: The proof uses an explicit Markov precision identity and controlled collision asymptotics; exact and finite diagnostics are distinguished from infinite limit proofs. No experimental data or independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite number of iid continuous-density nodes on a one-dimensional interval and the exact exponential covariance kernel; no claims for other Matérn smoothness, higher dimensions, growing sample counts, correlated sampling, GP prediction risk, or floating-point error. The novelty comparison is not an independent publication-priority review.
title: Universal collision-tail and nugget moment laws for random exponential-kernel matrices
